currentText: Provide the current-year beneficiary allocation record for Sam with separate components.
proposedText: Provide the current-year beneficiary allocation record for Sam with separate components, including TFN, full name, residential address, date of birth, and entity code.
quote: For individual beneficiaries, show: - tax file number (TFN) - full name, including title, family name, and given names - residential address (street address, not a PO Box) - date of birth - entity type code .
rationale: Current wording asks for allocation record with separate components but omits required beneficiary detail fields such as TFN, full name, residential address, and date of birth that the guidance specifies for individual beneficiaries.
